item.title: The Traveller to Legendary Lands
item.description: An interview conducted by Georgi Kapchits and published on WardheerNews on Sunday, 12 April 2009; WardheerNews re-posted it on 31 January 2015, and it was reprinted in the anthology KAYDSO: Qoraalladii Warsidaha BADSO 2014–2017 (pp. 265–273). The questions are Kapchits’s; the answers belong to Sheila Andrzejewski (the eight lines of verse are quoted in the translation by B. W. and Sheila Andrzejewski). The text is given as the author published it; nothing has been changed.
